svg.title: KOMOREBI COFFEE landing page wireframe
svg.desc: Static SVG wireframe converted from the KOMOREBI COFFEE HTML and CSS landing page.

g.text: A warm neighborhood cafe for morning plates, roasted coffee,
seasonal sweets, quiet reading time, takeout, and reservations.
Coffee and baked sweets are designed together.
Flavor, milk, butter, sweetness, and roast level are adjusted
for the mood of each day.
Small 18-seat cafe with Wi-Fi, takeout coffee,
baked sweets, and reservation-friendly weekend seats.
